note: What a server sends to place a prop on the map: a thing that stands there and is looked at rather than one that acts. In what order the three turns apply is not recorded here.

fields.name: prop
fields.note: The name the prop answers to, so later messages can name it.

fields.name: node
fields.note: Which network node the object belongs to. A client reads it apart from the name beside it rather than as that name's leading byte.

fields.name: skin
fields.note: Which look the prop wears.

fields.name: atX
fields.note: Where the prop stands, along one ground axis, in world units.

fields.name: atY
fields.note: Where the prop stands, in height, in world units.

fields.name: atZ
fields.note: Where the prop stands, along the other ground axis, in world units.

fields.name: rotationX
fields.note: An angle the prop is turned by about a ground axis, in degrees, from zero up to but not reaching 360. Zero for every prop observed on maps 1, 8 and 10.

fields.name: rotationY
fields.note: An angle the prop is turned by about the upright axis, in degrees, from zero up to but not reaching 360.

fields.name: rotationZ
fields.note: An angle the prop is turned by about the other ground axis, in degrees, from zero up to but not reaching 360. Zero for every prop observed on maps 1, 8 and 10.

fields.name: offsetX
fields.note: What is added to where it stands, along one ground axis.

fields.name: offsetY
fields.note: What is added to where it stands, in height.

fields.name: offsetZ
fields.note: What is added to where it stands, along the other ground axis.

fields.name: scaleX
fields.note: What its drawn size is scaled by, along one ground axis.

fields.name: scaleY
fields.note: What its drawn size is scaled by, in height.

fields.name: scaleZ
fields.note: What its drawn size is scaled by, along the other ground axis.

fields.name: team
fields.note: The side it belongs to, or zero where it belongs to none.

fields.name: rank
fields.note: How far it is advanced.

fields.name: skillLevel
fields.note: What level the prop's own doings stand at. Zero in everything observed.

fields.name: kind
fields.note: What sort of prop it is.

fields.name: name
fields.note: What this prop is called, so a client can tell one from another. Written out in full and padded with zero bytes to the width above.

fields.name: asset
fields.note: The name the client loads its art and sound under, written and padded as above.
